attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA will support the people of Puerto Rico in extricating themselves from the strictures of the Jones Act (1920) and related acts of the 1910s and 1920s that established U.S. control over shipping to Puerto Rico.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work to expand labor protections found within the Jones Act (1920) dealing with the rights of seafarers, fishers, and agricultural workers.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work with colonized peoples for the forgiveness of all debts and reparations to the survivors of exploitation, as well as their descendants, so as to allow the free political expression of the oppressed of these peoples.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA stands for the total dissolution of the United States empire.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) is dedicated to a world free of exploitation and oppression leading to the liberation of all people from capitalism and imperialism.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. is a prison house of nations founded on genocide, built by slavery, maintained by exploitation, and expanded through conquest.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. comprises many nations, recognized and unrecognized, including but not limited to the indigenous nations within the current continental U.S. borders, among them Hawaiʻi, Puerto Rico, Amerika Sāmoa, Guåhån, the Northern Mariana Islands, the Virgin Islands, lands occupied by military bases and installations, and other so-called “overseas territories” of the USA.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
